title: On a first visit the report defaults to the current calendar month and the user's currently active location
custom_preconds: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser that has never saved settings for this report (fresh browser profile or cleared site data).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Inventory Value report.
  2. Read the date-range control's value.
  3. Read the Location filter's selection.
custom_expected:
1. The date range defaults to the current calendar month.
  2. The location defaults to the user's currently active location.
